newsitem.title: USA: Winds threaten shipping in North Sea, Channel - WSC.
newsitem.headline: Winds threaten shipping in North Sea, Channel - WSC.

text.p: High winds in the North Sea and English Channel will continue to be hazardous to shipping during the next few days, independent forecaster Weather Services Corp said on Monday.
It forecast powerful southwest to west-southwest winds of 20-40 mph in the North Sea, with higher gusts. Conditions would be variably to mostly cloudy with scattered rains and showers.
Shipping and loading delays would continue as high winds created rough seas and port difficulties, WSC said.
